thread:
marc-sales: Need quick presales input for AtlasApp. They want enterprise commit guidance + prewarm plan. Traffic: baseline 4 rps, bursts to 45 rps (5-15m twice/day), tokens/day ~1.4M (80% short <=64t, 20% long >=768t). SLO: 99p < 330ms for short. Recommend reserved layout + autoscale? Pricing uplift?

ivy-eng: single region? model? long jobs continuous?

marc-sales: us-east-2. Using redwood-llama-13b-int8. Long jobs are batch exports at night but occasional daytime long completions.

tess-se: Proposal: reserve 2 x A100-80GB for baseline low-latency, +1 reserved prewarm slot (pinned weights + KV) -> total 3 reserved. Autoscale up to +2 burst GPUs (on-demand/spot) for spikes. Prewarm KV for top 150 prefixes.

raja-infra: Ops notes: spread reserved across 2 AZs (2/1). Allow burst as spot firstly, fallback to on-demand. Configure automatic route to quantized fallback model (llama-13b-quant) on spot eviction. Autoscale cooldown 75-120s to reduce flapping.

ivy-eng: perf ballpark: tuned batching -> ~1300 tok/s per A100 for short; long decoding ~600 tok/s. With token mix 2 reserved GPUs + prewarm slot handle baseline and predictable long jobs; bursts covered by +2.

noah-pm: Pricing: for 12mo commit we can offer 15% discount on GPU hourly and include 120 burst credits (1 credit = 1 GPU-hour). Need estimated burst hours to compute ARR.

marc-sales: they expect ~2.5h/day at peak -> ~75h/mo.

ops-bot: calc: reserved 3 GPUs * 24 * 30 = 2160 GPU-hrs/mo. Burst ~1.5 GPUs average *75h = 112.5h -> ~2272.5h/mo total. Apply discount in quote.

tess-se: Autoscale snippet for handoff (explain in prose too):
```json
{"min_reserved":3,"prewarm_slots":1,"scale_up_if":["rps>12","queue>25","gpu_util>70"],"scale_step":1,"max_burst":2,"cooldown_s":90,"fallback_model":"llama-13b-quant","kv_preload":"top_150"}
```
Note in doc: prewarm pins weights and warms KV prefixes 24h before demo.

raja-infra: add security/network bullets: support for customer KMS, VPC peering or PrivateLink for Private deployments, audit logs, SSO.

marc-sales: great. I'll draft presales handoff: sizing rationale, autoscale snippet, pricing sketch, AZ/spot fallback notes, demo prewarm runbook. Tagging @tess-se and @raja-infra for runbook and ops review.

ivy-eng: happy to join handover call if they want tech Qs.

marc-sales: thanks team. end of thread.
